=== Tab moves the item and its children under the previous sibling
--- given
- a
- b‸
  - c
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  - b‸
    - c

=== Tab on the first item of a list does nothing and swallows the key
--- given
- a‸
- b
--- when key Tab
--- then consumed
- a‸
- b

=== Tab on a first child does nothing and swallows the key
--- given
- a
  - b‸
  - c
--- when key Tab
--- then consumed
- a
  - b‸
  - c

=== Tab takes the indent step from the previous sibling's first child
--- given
- a
    - a1
- b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
    - a1
    - b‸

=== Tab prefers the sibling's own step over the step used elsewhere in the list
--- given
- x
   - x1
- a
    - a1
- b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- x
   - x1
- a
    - a1
    - b‸

=== Tab takes the indent step from the item itself when the sibling has no children
--- given
- p
    - a
    - b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- p
    - a
        - b‸

=== Tab prefers the item's own step over the step used elsewhere in the list
--- given
- p
  - a
- r
    - s
    - t‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- p
  - a
- r
    - s
        - t‸

=== Tab takes the indent step from elsewhere in the list before the editor's unit
--- given unit=2
- a
- b‸
- c
    - c1
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
    - b‸
- c
    - c1

=== Tab falls back to the editor's indent unit in a flat list (tab)
--- given unit=tab
- a
- b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
	- b‸

=== Tab falls back to the editor's indent unit in a flat list (four spaces)
--- given unit=4
- a
- b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
    - b‸

=== Tab renumbers both ordered groups
--- given
1. a
2. b‸
3. c
--- when key Tab
--- then
1. a
  1. b‸
2. c

=== Tab keeps a selection inside the item on its characters
--- given
- a
- ⟨bb⟩b
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  - ⟨bb⟩b

=== Tab with a selection across two items passes to the editor
--- given
- a
- ⟨b
- c⟩
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
- ⟨b
- c⟩

=== Tab into a folded sibling unfolds it so the item stays visible
--- given
- a ⊟
  - a1
- b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  - a1
  - b‸

=== Tab keeps the moved item's own fold
--- given
- a
- b‸ ⊟
  - c
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  - b‸ ⊟
    - c

=== Tab carries the item's notes lines
--- given
- a
- b‸
  a note
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  - b‸
    a note

=== Tab on a notes line indents the item that owns it
--- given
- a
- b
  a no‸te
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a
  - b
    a no‸te

=== Tab refuses a list that mixes tabs and spaces
--- given
- a
	- a1
- b
  - b1‸
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
	- a1
- b
  - b1‸

=== Tab passes to the editor when the Tab behaviour is switched off
--- given tab=off
- a
- b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
- b‸

=== Tab moves a task item and its box together
--- given
- [ ] a
- [x] b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- [ ] a
  - [x] b‸

=== Tab in a loose list treats the blank line as part of the list
--- given
- a

- b‸
--- when key Tab
--- then
- a

  - b‸
